title: database.restore_failed
description: A restore failed; the target is as before (`in_place`) or failed (`new_node`). `node_id` of the entry is the source database. Names, IDs and counts only: never a row value, a parameter or an engine message (decision 0004-8). This schema is the `data` of a journal entry with `type` `database.restore_failed`. Step 2, planned (decision 0004-21).
